statusLine.command: bash -c 'runtime=$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || command -v node); plugin_dir=$(ls -d "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-hud/claude-hud/*/ 2>/dev/null | awk -F/ '"'"'{ print $(NF-1) "\t" $0 }'"'"' | sort -t. -k1,1n -k2,2n -k3,3n -k4,4n | tail -1 | cut -f2-); src=$([ "$(basename "$runtime")" = "bun" ] && echo "src/index.ts" || echo "dist/index.js"); exec "$runtime" "${plugin_dir}${src}"'
